summary: New root entry, absent from both the assigned entry and the allowed ʕqb lookup. Searches mʕaq and gmaʕq likewise found no matching glossary material.

Only mʕaqabbe and mʕaqboli are attested. II is a plausible morphological classification; the printed base pair mʕaqable/mʕaqəb is explicitly a regular-pattern reconstruction, not an attested pair. No Infectum box or other unattested form is supplied.

mʕaqboli supports first-person agent -li and feminine object -o; mʕaqabbe plausibly has plural agents and b+l assimilation. The latter's trace object is supplied parenthetically by the edition, not overt in the Turoyo.

An Arabic ʕqb connection is plausible but no external dictionary was consulted and no etymology is asserted as established. The [RQ-light-verb] reader tag does not make either simple verb a light-verb construction.
All 10 records reviewed. The root is absent from the original glossary but already proposed in round 1; only new sense 2, Detransitive 1 and new box material are emitted here.

Kəmʕaqəb at Jan 3.15/189 now directly supports the Infectum base mʕaqəb. The earlier entire-pair reconstruction note is updated: Preterit citation mʕaqable remains reconstructed from inflected evidence.

mʕaqboli indexes feminine daʕwa plus first-person agent; rights are zero-marked after mʕaqbinawo. Person pursuit uses object -le, telephone monitoring resumes a fronted phone NP, and miʕaqbiwo promotes watched members without naming the observer.

Legal pursuit is an abstract-target extension. Phone monitoring plus the listening gloss supports a technical monitoring meaning, whose exact boundary with following developments remains open. Repeated night/day expressions are ordinary adjuncts, not fixed idioms.

No etymology is asserted beyond round 1’s provisional identification; new_root flags are stale relative to that baseline. Claims within political/poisoning narratives are source discourse, not independently verified historical facts. Project English is documentary machine translation.
Confirm root ʕqb and stem II with a speaker, including the reconstructed citation pair mʕaqable/mʕaqəb and the unattested Infectum vocalism.
In JTM 4.4/3 is the unexpressed object traces, Malke himself, or the inquiry generally? The current sense avoids a distinct investigative meaning.
Confirm segmentation of mʕaqboli as feminine object plus first-person L-agent, and of mʕaqabbe as plural with b+l assimilation.
Confirm the II citation pair and relation to tḥqb, which the reader compares; do not merge roots or assert an Arabic borrowing history without permitted lexical evidence.
At Jan 2.7/1840 mʕaqbila, resolve person/suffixes and whether the government pursued, prosecuted or punished the referent; only pursuit with subsequent capture is provisionally retained.
Does Mʕaqabnowo aq qonġəratani mean attending, following proceedings or monitoring them? No special attendance sense is proposed.
Confirm the technical boundary between tracking developments and surveillance at Jan 3.15/189, and the source status of the listening parenthesis in Jan 1.53/2558.
Jan confirms the round 1 pursuit sense with human night-and-day tracking and extends it to congresses, lawsuits, rights and procedures. These are not another new-root proposal.
